description: This file defines the configuration class 'AccountingAccrualConfiguration' for the '/accounting/accrual/starter' package in the Fineract project. It provides a Spring configuration that creates and manages a bean for 'AccrualAccountingWritePlatformService', conditionally instantiated if not already present. The class integrates dependencies such as 'LoanAccrualsProcessingService' and 'AccrualAccountingDataValidator' to instantiate 'AccrualAccountingWritePlatformServiceImpl'.

classes.name: AccountingAccrualConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring Configuration class that provides a bean for 'AccrualAccountingWritePlatformService' if it's missing from the context, wiring in the required dependencies.

methods.name: accrualAccountingWritePlatformService
methods.description: Factory method that returns an instance of 'AccrualAccountingWritePlatformServiceImpl', initialized with 'LoanAccrualsProcessingService' and 'AccrualAccountingDataValidator'.
